facts.text: John faced tough times while playing basketball and messed up during a big game, which was hard to accept.

evidence.quote: I faced some tough times while playing basketball. I messed up during a big game, and it was really hard to accept.

facts.text: John worked hard to get better after messing up during a big game and emphasized the importance of resilience and owning up to mistakes.

evidence.quote: Instead of getting stuck in that moment, I worked hard to get better. It taught me that resilience is key and owning up to mistakes is important.

facts.text: Tim acknowledged John's resilience and determination after he faced difficulties and expressed gratitude for his sharing.

evidence.quote: You did an amazing job staying focused and overcoming it. Your resilience and determination are inspiring! Thanks for sharing.

facts.text: John emphasized that difficult times are part of life and that remembering his passion for basketball helps him stay motivated.

evidence.quote: When things get tough, I try to remember why I'm so passionate about basketball. That love and enthusiasm keeps me motivated, no matter what.
